# MU:note

> MU:note is an iPhone practice log for musicians that counts only the time you actually play your instrument. It listens for the instrument you set — piano, strings, winds, voice, or guitar (acoustic and classical) — and leaves out silences longer than 15 seconds. Audio is analyzed on the device and never recorded. Made by munote, founded by Jisoo Kim, a music educator with a master's degree in music.

## Guides

- [Practice guides for musicians](https://oneumart.com/munote/guides/): research-checked guides for musicians on how to practice an instrument and keep track of it.
- [How to Keep a Music Practice Journal (and Actually Stick With It)](https://oneumart.com/munote/guides/practice-journal/): what to write after each session, why memory of practice time misleads, and how a journal helps you plan a piece by a deadline.
- [Free Music Practice Log Template (Printable PDF)](https://oneumart.com/munote/guides/practice-log-template/): a one-page printable practice log for any instrument, with a weekly review box.
